name: pattern-gates
facts: The catalog holds 33 patterns, each tagged with the registers it applies to
22 patterns are always on and never conflict with a house style
11 patterns are register-gated, plus personality injection; applying them blind is how a register-aware skill breaks documents
The four gate states are on, limited, elevated and off
§24 excessive hedging is limited in Technical and Regulated, because calibrated uncertainty there is content rather than hedging
§30 diff-anchored writing is elevated in Technical, the only elevated gate in the table
